title: Would you mod a game for me?
author: LiquidThoughtsG
selftext:
There is a list of single player games that I wish were coop. I think all of us gamers know that frustrating feeling of loving a game and just wishing we could experience it with our best buddy. Now that AI vibe coding games has become a bigger thing I think maybe it’s possible. I looked into it and it will take a little more know how then I currently possess.

Is anyone willing or interested in turning single player games into coop?

I was thinking start small. Escape from Duckov. It’s moddable, there are already some coop mods that have made progress. But I want a finished experience. Quests, progress, equipment, animations, enemies all synced. I want a buddy to be able to trade gear with and beat the game with. I think this is a pretty realistic starting place.

My perfect scenario would be Stalker 2 coop.

comments.body:
